params.message:
Settings offers the models the pipeline has, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 included

The routing panel offered three hardcoded ids with Opus 5 as the top; it now shows
the pipeline's four tiers from /config/models, Fable included, and a phase still on a
previous model shows that model ticked. Labels for Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1, and a
fallback that reads claude-opus-6-5 as Opus 6.5. Chat's Deep is Opus 5.5.
